title: Four trustlines from three operation sources in one transaction, one alphanum-12 at the int64-max limit
pattern: One transaction, three operation sources (alice, bob, mm), alphanum-4 and alphanum-12 assets, and a trustline limit of 922337203685.4775807 (int64 max stroops). Readers that attribute every operation to the transaction source, or parse the limit as a float, get it wrong.

hazards.placement: one transaction with operations from three different sources

facts.says: Operation 3 trusts the alphanum-12 code XPFLONGCODE1 with limit 9223372036854775807 stroops.
A trustline for XPFLONGCODE1 is created for mm.
